summary: Frontend-only verification of iteration_6 changes. REGRESSION FIX for AddChanda receipt-book/receipt-no auto-fill PASSES fully. Pencil edit buttons on all row types in MemberDetail work as designed (edit-chanda, edit-transfer, edit-transfer-in, edit-expense present; edit-reimb-in/out not exercised because seed Monu has no reimbursements). Two issues found: (1) The advertised 'Tap to edit entries' pill is NOT rendered on Member cards in /members — code inspection confirms no such element exists in Members.jsx. (2) MOBILE UX BUG: the fixed FAB Add button (bottom-right, w-14 h-14) overlays the right-side pencil icons of the LAST visible row on the MemberDetail page. Playwright reproduced this deterministically for the expense row pencil (bounding box x=325,y=774 in 390x844 viewport); FAB intercepts pointer events, so real mobile users cannot tap those pencils. Regression safety flows (Rename/Delete member modals, new chanda end-to-end save with auto-filled Book 2 #52) all pass.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Tap to edit entries' pill described in the review request is MISSING. Grep for 'Tap to edit' returns 0 matches. Member cards show only name + '{n} collections' + Currently Held + ⋮ menu.

ui_bugs.component: MemberDetail.jsx pencil row buttons vs Layout.jsx FAB
ui_bugs.issue: Mobile-only overlap: the fixed FAB Add button (data-testid=fab-add-btn, right-4 bottom, z-40, 56x56) intercepts pointer events for pencil icons on the bottom-most row of any section (e.g. edit-expense pencil at right-4 sits directly under the FAB). Reproduced with Playwright: click times out with 'fab-add-btn intercepts pointer events'. Users on mobile cannot tap those pencils unless the row is scrolled up. Same overlap risk with bottom nav bar for a row that lands under the ~72px bottom nav.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' caused by dev-tool instrumentation wrapping the option label in a <span>. Harmless in prod but pollutes logs and can cause hydration mismatches — safe to ignore for now, but worth noting.

action_items: Add the 'Tap to edit entries' pill next to the member name in Members.jsx member-card-{name} (or update the review request wording). Currently zero such pill is rendered.

Fix mobile FAB overlap: either (a) hide FAB on MemberDetail route, (b) add bottom padding (pb-24) to the MemberDetail container so last-row pencil clears the FAB & bottom nav, or (c) move the row pencil to the left side / stagger it away from FAB x-range.
critical_code_review_comments: AddChanda.jsx: userEditedNoRef correctly gates auto-fill of receipt_no — verified 88 sticks across book switches. No issue.
AddChanda.jsx: in edit mode, receipt_no is loaded from editing.receipt_no but userEditedNoRef starts false; because the auto-fill effect is guarded by `!editing`, this is safe.
MemberDetail.jsx: correctly hides pencil for voided rows.
Layout.jsx FAB (fab-add-btn) has z-40 same as bottom nav; on member detail pages the FAB has no reason to appear because /add is 2 taps away via bottom nav — consider hiding it on non-list routes.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (2 of 5 stated features have issues: missing pill + FAB overlay)

rca of the issue: Pill missing: Members.jsx never got the described pill element — likely lost in a diff or the description was aspirational. Grep 'Tap to edit' → 0 hits. FAB overlap: Layout.jsx renders <button data-testid='fab-add-btn' class='md:hidden fixed right-4 z-40 w-14 h-14'> anchored at bottom-right on mobile; MemberDetail's row action pencils are also at the right edge with no bottom padding, so the last row's pencil (y≈774 in a 844px viewport) sits under the FAB and pointer events resolve to the FAB. Fix: either hide FAB on member detail route or add pb-24 to the MemberDetail root <div>.
